findings.evidence: WHOIS fallback ... then `whois -h <server> <name>` (label rule at line 26: 'its WHOIS said "not found"')
findings.fix: Add a WHOIS classification rule: 'Registry WHOIS phrasing varies (for example .de returns "Status: free", others "No match" or "NOT FOUND").
